Title: General Availability: Azure Database for MySQL Import feature for Azure Database for MySQL Single to Flexible Server migrations

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MySQL – Single Server is being retired by September 16,2024. To facilitate seamless migration from Azure Database for MySQL – Single Server to Flexible Server, we’re pleased to announce the general availability of Azure Database for MySQL Import.


With Azure Database for MySQL Import, you can now migrate an Azure Database for MySQL - Single Server instance to Azure Database for MySQL- Flexible Server by running a single CLI command.
Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server is the best platform for running your MySQL workloads on Azure. It is a fully managed database service designed to provide granular control and flexibility over database management functions and configuration settings for your MySQL workloads.


Learn more about how to migrate.
